fixes.explanation: I wish that worked, but the verse says the opposite. Solomon says, “He who trusts in his riches will fall…” Picture a man leaning his whole weight on his money, and down he goes. Then the verse turns to the righteous, who “will thrive like foliage.” Leafy and green, still growing.

problems.problem: The explanation still restates the contrast between falling and thriving without developing it.
